assessment_scope: Source-code and configuration review plus production build; no live provider, infrastructure, legal, or penetration-test verification.

issues.summary: Passenger profiles are automatically marked verified during signup/profile loading, and a migration explicitly enables instant verification. This conflicts with the intended ID/selfie and admin-review flow and may permit rides before safety approval.
issues.fix: Remove automatic verification from signup, profile loading, triggers, and migrations. Require explicit admin approval; add database-backed regression tests that pending and rejected passengers cannot create rides.

issues.summary: Ride fare is calculated from client-supplied distance. The database bounds the value but does not independently verify the route, allowing submitted distance to differ from actual route distance.
issues.fix: Calculate or validate route distance on a trusted backend and derive fare from the verified route.

issues.summary: The number is displayed as a contact phone, but the repository has no OTP issuance/verification flow or WhatsApp provider integration. Account authentication is email/password.
issues.fix: Verify the number and provider account out of band; implement server-side OTP with consent, expiry, attempt limits, abuse controls, delivery handling, and production testing.

issues.summary: The landing page links to Terms and Privacy pages, but corresponding routes/content are not implemented. Consent, cancellation/refund, and safety policies are not evidenced.
issues.fix: Create reviewed legal documents, implement working public routes, and test direct navigation and fresh-page loads.

issues.summary: The consolidated schema is documented for fresh projects while separate migrations are present; passenger instant-verification migration behavior conflicts with the documented admin-review flow. Deployed migration state is unknown.
issues.fix: Reconcile a single authoritative schema/migration history and validate fresh install and upgrade paths against staging, including RLS and storage policies.

issues.summary: Paystack Edge Functions exist, but live secrets, webhook/callback configuration, end-to-end payment behavior, and driver payout/settlement are not verified; the README identifies payout/settlement as unfinished.
issues.fix: Test payment lifecycle in staging, validate provider configuration and duplicate-event handling, implement payout/settlement, and document operational reconciliation.

issues.summary: package.json has no test/lint scripts. Rate limiting, centralized error monitoring, and operational alerts are not evidenced in the reviewed source.
issues.fix: Add targeted automated tests, API abuse controls, error monitoring, and an on-call/incident response process.

issues.summary: Capacitor configuration exists, but native release/signing, device testing, background location, and push-notification behavior were not verified; the README lists push notifications as outstanding.
issues.fix: Build and test target native apps on devices, validate permissions/background behavior, and implement/test push notifications before relying on them.

issues.summary: The production build emitted a map-related JavaScript chunk of approximately 1.92 MB minified (about 540 KB gzip) and a large-chunk warning.
issues.fix: Lazy-load map features, split mapping dependencies, and benchmark startup and interaction on representative mobile devices and networks.

issues.summary: The repository has environment-variable examples and Vercel SPA rewrites, but production secrets, Supabase Auth redirect/email settings, provider configuration, domain HTTPS, backups, and monitoring were not verified.
issues.fix: Configure and verify production values in provider dashboards, keep secrets out of source control, and run a production-like smoke test and rollback exercise.

issues.summary: The recurring selfie screen has a 'Skip for now' action and is client-side only, so it is not an identity-verification guarantee.
issues.fix: Do not use the prompt as an identity control; use a server-enforced verification process appropriate to the safety requirement.

verification.production_build_warning: Vite reported an oversized map-related JavaScript chunk.
